channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: North Palm Beach Celebrates Fourth of July with Fireworks and Pool Party at Country Club
item.description: North Palm Beach residents and visitors will celebrate Independence Day with a full day of family-friendly activities, live entertainment and fireworks at North Palm Beach Country Club and The Clubhouse on July 4.

item.title: Riviera Beach named only Florida city to win 2026 All-America City Award
item.description: Riviera Beach was selected as one of just 10 communities nationwide to receive the prestigious All-America City Award from the National Civic League, the only Florida city honored this year.

item.title: Juno Beach residents want fence replaced at JB-7 beach access as trespassing disputes escalate
item.description: Residents at the Colony Condos say people using the JB-7 public walkway are cutting through their private property since the town removed the old fence in 2023 for safety reasons.

item.title: Stuart downtown dock closes Monday for $3 million renovation to nearly double boat slip capacity
item.description: Stuart's downtown public dock will shut down July 6 for a major renovation expected to wrap up by next Fourth of July. item.title: Martin County School Board fights judge's order to reinstate teacher suspended over Charlie Kirk Facebook post
item.description: The Martin County School Board is pushing back against an administrative law judge's recommendation to reinstate a Spectrum Academy teacher who was suspended after posting social media comments about Charlie Kirk.

item.title: Florida advances ban on undocumented students at state colleges as Byron Donalds leads GOP governor's race
item.description: Florida's State Board of Education voted this week to advance rules that would prevent undocumented students from enrolling in the state's 28 public colleges and adult education programs, including GED preparation courses. item.title: Hobe Sound community raises funds for man whose fiancée died in Monday house fire
item.description: Friends of Misty Dawn White launched a fundraiser to help her fiancé Mark rebuild after a fire destroyed their Hobe Sound home and killed White earlier this week.

item.title: Port St. Lucie approves land transfer for new Florida Turnpike interchange at Midway Road
